name: Process control and monitoring via SCADA/DCS, remote from shore or hub platform
description: Minimum-facility WHPs are normally unmanned; supervisory control gathers wellhead/process data to a hub platform or onshore centre over radio, cellular, fibre or satellite links. Control loops stay in local PLC/RTU, with SCADA as supervisory layer; safety functions are implemented in a separate SIS. Primary source: https://tatsoft.com/oil-gas/
aliases: Process control and monitoring via SCADA/DCS, remote from shore or hub platform
